comments: The draft plan describes fixing syntax errors (use statements, property definitions) in InTransitResource.php and LossLedger.php. These changes correct code to work as intended and do not introduce security vulnerabilities. Fixing $fillable and $casts ensures proper mass assignment protection and attribute casting. The modifyQueryUsing function in InTransitResource.php already implements appropriate row-level security. No security controls are weakened by the proposed changes.
